-- types.mms --
Type Wave {
  mob: Id<entity_type>
  count: int = 1
}
Type Mode = "rigid" | "terrain_matching"
Type Broken = Strnig
Type Things = Id<not_a_registry>

Blueprint Spawner {
  waves: [Wave]
  mode: Mode = "rigid"
  pool: LootPool?
  emit {
    Function ${self.path} {
      /say ${mode}
    }
  }
}

Spawner fine {
  waves = [{ mob = zombie, count = 2 }, { mob = skeleton }]
  mode = "terrain_matching"
}

Spawner wrong {
  waves = [{ mob = not_a_mob }, { mob = zombie, count = "two" }]
  mode = "wobbly"
  pool = Pool(1..3, diamond)
}

Template Repeat(n: int, item: Id<item>) = Pool(n, ${item})
LootTable t {
  pools = [Repeat("x", stone), Repeat(2, not_an_item), Repeat(1, diamond)]
}

const spacing: int = "far"
const good: LootPool = Pool(1, diamond)
const woods = [oak, birch]
for w in woods {
  LootTable crates/${w} { pools = [Repeat(1, ${w}_planks), Repeat(1, ${w}_plonks)] }
}
